```{r}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
library(dplyr)
# load data

train <- read.csv("playground-series-s6e3/train.csv")
test  <- read.csv("playground-series-s6e3/test.csv")

# target variable is called Churn
```

## LOOK AT DATA

```{r}
head(train) 
names(train) # column names
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(train))  # no na values
sum(is.na(test))  # no na values
```

```{r}
# summary of data
summary(train)
```

```{r}
# range of vals for numerical cols
numeric_cols <- names(train)[sapply(train, is.numeric)]
numeric_cols <- setdiff(numeric_cols, "id")

range_compare <- data.frame(
  feature = numeric_cols,
  train_min = sapply(train[numeric_cols], min),
  train_max = sapply(train[numeric_cols], max),
  test_min  = sapply(test[numeric_cols], min),
  test_max  = sapply(test[numeric_cols], max)
)

print(range_compare)
```

```{r}
# see values for cat cols
## see which we have to make 0/1 and which to one
# hot encode

cat_cols <- names(train)[sapply(train, is.character)]

for(col in cat_cols){

  cat("\n====================\n")
  cat("Column:", col, "\n")

  cat("\nTrain values:\n")
  print(unique(train[[col]]))

  cat("\nTest values:\n")
  print(unique(test[[col]]))

}
```

## DATA CLEANING

```{r}
# make yes/no cols into binary cols

train <- train |>
  mutate(
    gender = ifelse(gender == "Male", 1, 0),
    Partner = ifelse(Partner == "Yes", 1, 0),
    Dependents = ifelse(Dependents == "Yes", 1, 0),
    PhoneService = ifelse(PhoneService == "Yes", 1, 0),
    PaperlessBilling = ifelse(PaperlessBilling == "Yes", 1, 0),
    Churn = ifelse(Churn == "Yes", 1, 0)
  )

test <- test |>
  mutate(
    gender = ifelse(gender == "Male", 1, 0), 
    Partner = ifelse(Partner == "Yes", 1, 0),
    Dependents = ifelse(Dependents == "Yes", 1, 0),
    PhoneService = ifelse(PhoneService == "Yes", 1, 0),
    PaperlessBilling = ifelse(PaperlessBilling == "Yes", 1, 0)
  )
```


```{r}
# one hot encode the rest of the variables

train <- train |>
  mutate(
    MultipleLines = as.factor(MultipleLines),
    InternetService = as.factor(InternetService),
    OnlineSecurity = as.factor(OnlineSecurity),
    OnlineBackup = as.factor(OnlineBackup),
    DeviceProtection = as.factor(DeviceProtection),
    TechSupport = as.factor(TechSupport),
    StreamingTV = as.factor(StreamingTV),
    StreamingMovies = as.factor(StreamingMovies),
    Contract = as.factor(Contract),
    PaymentMethod = as.factor(PaymentMethod)
  )

test <- test |>
  mutate(
    MultipleLines = as.factor(MultipleLines),
    InternetService = as.factor(InternetService),
    OnlineSecurity = as.factor(OnlineSecurity),
    OnlineBackup = as.factor(OnlineBackup),
    DeviceProtection = as.factor(DeviceProtection),
    TechSupport = as.factor(TechSupport),
    StreamingTV = as.factor(StreamingTV),
    StreamingMovies = as.factor(StreamingMovies),
    Contract = as.factor(Contract),
    PaymentMethod = as.factor(PaymentMethod)
  )
```
